name: eigen
description: Eigen: a team of personal agents (engine) and the studio to orchestrate them (app).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n engine,app -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @eigen/engine" "npm run dev -w @eigen/app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eigen/engine && npm run build -w @eigen/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eigen/engine && npm run typecheck -w @eigen/app
scripts.start: npm run build -w @eigen/engine && npm run serve -w @eigen/engine
